question: What is the range of total stacked bar heights across the five states shown? (A) about 5 to 15 (B) about 10 to 25 (C) about 20 to 35. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: C (about 20 to 35). Bait: B (about 10 to 25).
